targets.rawSql: SELECT 'DRIVE' AS metric, ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN spd > 0.5 AND thr > 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') AS spd, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent') AS thr, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Brake_Active') AS brk FROM telemetry_samples WHERE session_uid::text = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') GROUP BY 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'COAST/PUSH', ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN spd > 0.5 AND thr <= 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') AS spd, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent') AS thr, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Brake_Active') AS brk FROM telemetry_samples WHERE session_uid::text = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') GROUP BY 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'BRAKE', ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN brk > 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') AS spd, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent') AS thr, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Brake_Active') AS brk FROM telemetry_samples WHERE session_uid::text = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') GROUP BY 1) s UNION ALL SELECT 'STOP', ROUND((AVG(CASE WHEN spd <= 0.5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') AS spd, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent') AS thr, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Brake_Active') AS brk FROM telemetry_samples WHERE session_uid::text = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') GROUP BY 1) s;
